name: Wordhawk
tagline: A converted 3D printer that plays a word game by itself using computer vision.

awards: Best Use of MemryX Edge AI Accelerator

problem: The team wanted to build a fun autonomous system from vision to motion.
solution: Local OCR reads the board, a trie search finds words, Gemini adds definitions, and a Raspberry Pi sends G-code so the printer traces the words.
demo_moment: Team-described: the robot plays and beats the game.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of MemryX Edge AI Accelerator” among 122 submissions.
Repurposes a 3D printer as a robot.

lessons: A machine playing a game is an instant crowd demo.
